sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored GGUF: Abliterated Local Build
sources.snippet: Bottom line "Qwen 3.8 27B uncensored GGUF" has an answer, and it is a concrete download: Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF — F16 plus 12 quantization tiers for llama.cpp, the abliterated weights from our FP8 build, 262K context, vision, and MTP, under Apache 2.0 and research-only.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Uncensored vs Other Qwen GGUF Models
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-27B-UNCENSORED-GGUF is a GGUF image-to-text and text-to-text model maintained by dealignai. The supplied model description identifies the build as Qwen3.8-27B-CRACK-GGUF, a refusal-removed derivative of Qwen3.8-27B with native vision-language support, video-frame understanding, controllable reasoning, coding ability, and a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP) head.
